patients.summary: Daycare teacher with chronic hypertension on labetalol who joins in 2023, has a second pregnancy complicated by poor fetal growth (delivered at 37 weeks in 2024), then a right attic cholesteatoma treated surgically in 2025 and right lower lobe bronchiectasis found after a pneumonia in late 2025. Last seen February 2026.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care practice
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Received 38 pages from prior primary care office (visits 2019 through spring 2023). Summary abstracted for the chart:

- Hypertension, chronic, picked up on repeat office readings about 2020, before her first pregnancy. Labetalol 200 mg twice daily since that pregnancy; prior office kept her on it as she was planning another.
- Prenatal vitamin daily.
- One term vaginal delivery 2021, uncomplicated per their notes.
- Ear tubes both sides as a child.
- Cervical cytology with HPV co-test 2021: negative for intraepithelial lesion, HPV not detected.
- Former smoker. NKDA.
- Last BMP and lipids there unremarkable.

Originals scanned to Media.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, new patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT

31F here to establish. Prior PCP records reviewed (see Media).

HTN: told she had high BP around 2020 on several office checks, before her first baby. Put on labetalol during that pregnancy and simply stayed on it - 200 mg BID. Takes it with breakfast and dinner, rarely misses. No home cuff. No headaches, chest pain, visual change. She and her husband would like a second child in the next year or so, which is why the prior office left her on labetalol. Already taking a prenatal vitamin daily.

PMH: HTN. Lots of ear infections as a kid, tubes in both ears; no ear trouble as an adult.
PSH: tympanostomy tubes (childhood). OB: G1P1, SVD 2021 at term, no complications she knows of.
Meds: labetalol 200 mg BID; prenatal vitamin daily.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: mother and father both with high blood pressure.
SH: preschool/daycare teacher (toddler room). Smoked in her late teens and early 20s, roughly 5 pack-years, stopped at 26. No alcohol. No drugs. Married, one child.

ROS: negative except as above.

Exam: BP and HR as charted, at goal on labetalol. Well-appearing. HEENT: TMs intact bilaterally with some old tube scarring, canals clear. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear to auscultation throughout. Abd soft. No LE edema. Skin warm.

A/P
1. Chronic hypertension - controlled on labetalol 200 BID. Reasonable agent given pregnancy plans; continue. Discussed home BP cuff. Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids, UA.
2. Preconception - continue prenatal vitamin. Asked her to message us when pregnant so we can get her to OB early.
3. Health maintenance: Pap/HPV 2021 normal, next due 2026. HIV and hep C screening offered, accepted. Flu and COVID this autumn at a nurse visit. PHQ-2 0.

RTC 6 months for BP.

documents.title: Your recent labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Wendy - everything from last week came back fine: kidney function, potassium, blood counts, cholesterol and urine all normal, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to change. Keep up the labetalol and we'll check in again in the new year.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In after work for vaccines. Not pregnant per pt. No prior reactions. Influenza 0.5 mL IM L deltoid; COVID 2023-24 formula IM R deltoid. VIS given. Observed 15 min, tolerated well. BP checked while here, see vitals.
